topic: Virtual facility data mapping and testing
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: first, the required date range for Brazil data (June 1st to current). Second, a technical issue regarding 358 virtual facilities whose mapping changed from physical. The discussion centered on whether historical session data needed to be deleted and replaced with new data due to this change. It was determined that simply re-linking the mapping is sufficient for now, and a decision on recalculating historical data will wait until testing with actual data the next day.

Later, new virtual facility data in STAGE was aggregated and made available for testing.
decisions: For Brazil data, the required range is from June 1st to the current date.
The immediate action regarding changed virtual facilities (358 units) is to simply re-link the mapping; historical session history recalculation will be deferred until further testing.
action_items: Check and decide on the necessity of historical data recalculation using actual data tomorrow.
